answer: Primary Zone 13 (Node 1):The first highlighted zone is Node 13. This zone contains three conditions: HNRNP2A2B1>0.323, TUBB64B>0.474, and RPLP10<0.131. According to our analysis, these three conditions together can lead to the positive regulation of Ki-767.Tubulin beta 4b (TUBB4) is a member of the tubulin family of proteins. It encodes a subunit of microtubules, which are part of the cytoskeleton and involved in intracellular transport within cells. The encoded protein is a component of the mitotic spindle during cell division and plays a role in the formation of centrosomes. In addition, it may play a role in cell differentiation and neuronal development.Ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P10 (RSP10) is a eukaryotic ribosome protein. Ribosomous proteins are routinely found in all living organisms and participate in protein biosynthesis in living cells. These proteins are also involved in other important cellular processes such as cell growth, differentiation, aging, and programmed cell death.Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A2/B1 (hnRNP A2/ B1) is a ubiquitous nucleoplasmic protein involved in various aspects of mRNA metabolism, including transcription, pre-mRNA splicing, polyadenylation, translation, and mRNA stability. In addition to its well-established roles in the nucleus, hnRNP A/B1 shuttles between the nucleus and cytoplasm depending on the cell cycle phase and cell signaling status.
